epistemicBoundary.purpose: minimal Game-owned measurement/semantic contract for control, performance, skill and shared/assisted execution
doesNotClaim: that PlayerValue is authoritatively known before empirical validation
that assistance effects on immediate performance imply durable Human learning
that synthetic capability profiles imply Human experience or motor mechanisms

objects.definition: declares whose capability is being inferred, over which task family, control configurations, evaluation/value targets and probe transformations
objects.guard: Skill claims without an explicit scope are incomplete

objects.definition: Game-local semantic action identities, admission/current legality, controlled loci and authoritative consequence semantics
objects.guard: physical movement/input implementation does not define GameAction identity

objects.definition: context-sensitive transformation from input evidence/control expression into control variables and/or candidate GameActions
objects.guard: same GameAction may have multiple mappings; same raw input may denote different GameActions by context

objects.definition: declares which controller contributes to which variable/layer/time interval and with what authority/transform role
objects.guard: controller contribution cannot be reduced to one percent-manual number

objects.definition: declared target of the current skill claim: formal Game goal/evaluation, local task objective, or explicit PlayerValue hypothesis
objects.guard: formal score, PlayerValue and research metric are not interchangeable

objects.definition: variables admitted before expert telemetry because their variation is causally connected under the current GameStructure/control configuration to a declared evaluation/value target and is participant/system influenceable or itself the evaluated controlled variable
admissionRules: variable has explicit provenance/observability or derivation semantics
there is an authoritative causal path from the variable to a declared EvaluationTarget, or the variable is directly declared as an evaluated control/expression target
the variable is within the influence/exposure surface of the attribution target under the current ControlContributionTopology
expert telemetry may validate predictive usefulness but must not create causal/evaluative relevance post hoc
objects.guard: TaskRelevantVariableSet is evaluation- and configuration-relative, not a universal list

objects.definition: one provenance-bound observation of task-relevant variables and outcomes under an exact task/configuration/history condition
objects.guard: PerformanceSample is evidence about capability, not Skill by identity

objects.definition: an exact declared transformation between baseline and probe tasks/configurations used to interpret retention, transfer, remapping, perturbation or adaptation
objects.guard: near/far transfer labels without transformation identity are insufficient

objects.definition: learned, history-dependent conditional capability profile over one SkillScopeSpec, inferred from distributions of TaskRelevantVariables across declared conditions/probes
objects.formalSketch: P(TRV outcomes | subject history, task family, control configuration, probe transformation)
comparison: profile-local dominance when one profile is no worse on all declared ordered targets/conditions and better on at least one
otherwise profiles can remain incomparable without hidden weighting
objects.guard: no mandatory scalarization; peak, robustness, transfer, retention and efficiency are not globally ordered

objects.definition: derived family of recurrent policy/execution organizations sharing declared functional invariants while permitting parameterization, mapping-specific realization and online correction
objects.guard: TechniqueFamily is not one exact trajectory or fixed parameter sequence and is not required for every Skill

objects.definition: history-sensitive evidence that a SkillProfile changed durably rather than transient PerformanceSample change
objects.guard: no single probe is mandatory for every skill claim, but the claim must match the evidence timescale/scope

derivedRelations.definition: minimum region of SkillProfile capability needed to satisfy a declared viability/evaluation threshold under one exact Game/control configuration
derivedRelations.guard: not an intrinsic scalar property of a Game; changes with mapping, assistance, task condition, threshold and performer-relevant dimensions

derivedRelations.definition: range of task/evaluation differences that changes in the attribution target's SkillProfile can causally express under the current GameStructure, mapping and contribution topology
derivedRelations.guard: high latent capability may be hidden by automation, saturation, coarse action resolution or inaccessible mapping

derivedRelations.definition: region beyond which further improvement on a declared capability dimension no longer creates distinguishable change in the declared evaluation/value targets under the current configuration
derivedRelations.guard: not a universal maximum human skill and generally multidimensional

derivedRelations.definition: which GameAction/control distinctions are reachable/executable by one subject under a particular input mapping and bodily/technical constraints
derivedRelations.guard: access can change while GameAction semantics remain fixed

derivedRelations.definition: SkillProfile attributed separately to Human, assist/system, synthetic controller or joint controller using the same scope semantics where possible
derivedRelations.guard: joint performance does not automatically credit Human-independent skill or system-independent skill

strongLaws: TaskRelevantVariableSet derives from GameStructure/evaluation/control relevance before expert telemetry
SkillProfile comparison can be partial/incomparable without declared weighting

externalPressure.use: functional task difficulty depends on performer skill, nominal difficulty and practice condition; pressures intrinsic fixed skill-floor/difficulty thinking

externalPressure.source: IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering 61(12):2869-2881, DOI 10.1109/TBME.2014.2332359
externalPressure.use: expertise interacts with freehand versus robotic teleoperation in task-relevant/task-irrelevant variability structure; interface/control configuration changes skill expression

externalPressure.source: Control Interface Remapping for Bias-Aware Assistive Teleoperation, arXiv:2205.08489
externalPressure.use: user-specific remapping improved control-space reachability in an evaluation with six participants with upper-limb motor impairments; supports mapping-relative access rather than fixed GameAction demand

externalPressure.source: Shared Autonomy for Proximal Teaching, HRI 2025 / arXiv:2502.19899
externalPressure.use: shared autonomy was used to identify/practice interpretable racing subskills in a 50-participant user study, showing assistance can be part of teaching/curriculum and not only execution substitution
